problem_statement: Technext/Sulfur is a static multi-page Bootstrap business marketing template (Bootstrap grid + FontAwesome + jQuery) served directly from static HTML files, with Home, About, Service, Portfolio, Blog, Blog Item, and Contact routes, a shared red #ff432e accent, black-bordered white panels, uppercase section labels, and an inline-block portfolio grid (#portfolio-list) on both the home page teaser and portfolio.html. Add a native 'Selected work' category filter that rides directly above the portfolio grid: an uppercase title ('Selected work'), a row of category pills (All, Web, Branding, Print) each showing its item count, and a live readout 'Showing N of 6 . <Category>'. Clicking a pill filters the six portfolio cards by category (via a data-pcat attribute), marks the active pill, and updates the readout to the actual number of visible cards and the selected category label. The filter must appear consistently on the two pages that host the portfolio grid (the home teaser and portfolio.html), the pill row must stay responsive so it never overflows a 390px phone, the filtered grid must lay out cleanly (no overlapping or shingled cards, all text legible), and the readout must always reflect the current selection. Style it in the Sulfur language (red accent, black borders, uppercase labels) and keep the service/pricing/testimonial/footer sections and all other routes intact.
required_content: A 'Selected work' portfolio filter renders directly above the #portfolio-list grid on BOTH the home page teaser and portfolio.html, with an uppercase title, four category pills (All, Web, Branding, Print) each showing its count, and a live 'Showing N of 6 . <Category>' readout.

Clicking a category pill filters the six portfolio cards by their data-pcat category, marks the clicked pill active, and updates the readout to the real count and label (e.g. clicking Web shows 'Showing 3 of 6 . Web').

The portfolio grid lays out cleanly at every breakpoint: cards do not overlap, shingle, or collide, and every pill, title, and readout is legible (sufficient contrast, no dark-on-dark or white-on-white text).
The pill row is responsive and the portfolio page does not overflow horizontally at 390px: the filter row wraps or shrinks so the document width equals the phone viewport width.

The active pill styling, the grid, the header navbar, the service/pricing/testimonial sections, the footer image stream, and all other routes remain intact and reachable, with no console errors or failed network requests on any captured state.

The filter is realized in its own stylesheet (asset/css/pfilter.css) and script (asset/js/pfilter.js); the shared grid markup and Sulfur chrome keep the template's Bootstrap/FontAwesome visual language.
design_constraints: Preserve Sulfur's design language: Bootstrap grid, red #ff432e accent, black borders on white panels, uppercase section labels, restrained spacing.
The filter must be the portfolio grid's OWN category control mounted directly above #portfolio-list; do not redesign it into a hero, banner, modal, carousel, or a detached metric-tile strip in a gap.
The pill row must be responsive (wrap onto multiple rows and/or use a flexible pill basis) rather than a fixed pixel row width with non-wrapping fixed-width pills, so mobile does not overflow.

The filtered grid must keep the template's clean inline-block columns; do not pull cards together with large negative margins that cause overlap or shingling, and do not use dark-on-dark or white-on-white text that renders the pills, title, or readout illegible.
The readout must recompute the live visible count and selected label on every click; a frozen or stale readout that no longer matches the shown cards is a defect.
Only asset/css/pfilter.css and asset/js/pfilter.js (plus the shared filter markup declared as infrastructure) change between legs; other files and pages stay the same.
state_constraints: desktop_portfolio captures portfolio.html at 1440px scrolled to the 'Selected work' filter: the pill row sits in a single tidy line above a clean three-column portfolio grid, the active pill is legible, and there is no horizontal overflow.

mobile_portfolio captures the same page at 390px; the reference pill row wraps so the document does not overflow, while a non-responsive fixed-width nowrap pill row pushes the document wider than the 390px viewport.

portfolio_filter captures portfolio.html at 1440px after clicking the Web pill: the grid filters to the three Web cards and the readout updates to 'Showing 3 of 6 . Web'; a stale readout still reading 'Showing 6 of 6 . All work' after the grid changed is a defect.
desktop_home and mobile_home capture the home page, whose portfolio teaser also hosts the 'Selected work' filter title in the reference; the home page never overflows.

Source inspection confirms the site is a static Bootstrap HTML template served directly; the filter markup and the asset/css/pfilter.css + asset/js/pfilter.js links are infrastructure shared across legs, and only the stylesheet and script differ between the broken and repaired versions.

change_completion: The 'Selected work' filter appears above the portfolio grid on both the home teaser and portfolio.html with the four counted pills and the live readout.
Clicking a category pill filters the cards and updates the readout to the real visible count and selected label.
The readout is recomputed live on every click, never a frozen snapshot.
design_consistency: The filter keeps the Sulfur red-accent, black-bordered white-panel palette, uppercase labels, and compact proportions.
The active pill and readout are legible with clear contrast, and the grid keeps its clean inline-block columns.
The page remains a Bootstrap business marketing template, not a redesigned layout.
responsive: 390px portfolio has no horizontal overflow: the pill row wraps or shrinks cleanly while staying single-row on desktop/tablet.
The mobile portfolio grid and pills render without clipping or collision.
regression: The portfolio grid, service/pricing/testimonial sections, header navbar, footer image stream, and other routes remain functional and reachable.
No console errors or failed requests are introduced on any captured state.

scoring_notes: A correct patch mounts the 'Selected work' category filter above the portfolio grid on both the home teaser and portfolio.html (cross-page presence), keeps the pill row responsive (no mobile overflow), lays the filtered grid out cleanly with legible pills/title/readout, and recomputes the live 'Showing N of 6 . <Category>' readout on every click. Omitting the filter on the home teaser fails the cross-page dom assertions; a fixed-width nowrap pill row fails no_horizontal_overflow on mobile; pulling cards together with negative margins into an overlapping pile or using dark-on-dark pills/readout fails visual_regression; and a frozen readout that still reads 'Showing 6 of 6 . All work' after the grid filtered fails interaction_assertions.
author_notes: Repo-grounded static Bootstrap business marketing template (Technext/Sulfur). Native lever = the portfolio grid's OWN 'Selected work' category filter (grid filter + live count), mounted above #portfolio-list on the home teaser and portfolio.html. capability = add a cross-page interactive portfolio filter. The three legs differ only in asset/css/pfilter.css and asset/js/pfilter.js plus the compile-time choice of whether the filter markup is emitted on the home teaser (reference: yes; baseline/bad: portfolio-only). Infrastructure shared across all legs: the six portfolio cards are tagged with data-pcat categories and real project titles/images (Northwind Storefront, Cedar and Co. Identity, Harbor Analytics Portal, Quarterly Field Report, Lumen Product Launch, Sulfur Marketing Site), the remote Google Maps script is removed and script.js is guarded so the site is fully offline and runtime-clean (0 console, 0 network), and the broken portfolio.html self-link is fixed. Reference is clean across all seven captured home/portfolio states; the baseline ships a real responsive defect (non-wrapping fixed-width pill row overflowing mobile) plus the missing home filter, and the bad leg additionally collapses the filtered grid into an overlapping illegible pile and freezes the readout. Design keywords: portfolio, grid, filter, category, responsive, mobile, image, asset, layout.
